title: Okvorado — Traffic Summary
description: Page d'accueil : porte d'entrée unique. Réplique la page 'Traffic Summary' de NetFlow Analyzer — liste paginée des exportateurs (Interfaces/Flows/IP), état des liens, Top N Protocol/Application/QoS, Top N Conversation. Chaque ligne d'exportateur pointe vers sa fiche détaillée (drill-down, dataLink var-exporter). Filtre $exporter (multi) : ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote}) — jamais IN ($exporter) ni comparaison à $__all (Code: 62 SYNTAX_ERROR mesuré).

list.name: exporter
list.label: Exportateur
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ExporterName FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) ORDER BY ExporterName

panels.title: Liste des exportateurs — Interfaces | Flux | IP
panels.description: Un exportateur par ligne, avec son nombre d'interfaces, son volume de flux observés et son IP. Cliquer une ligne (colonne 'exportateur') ouvre sa fiche détaillée (dataLink → dashboard 'Par exportateur', variable var-exporter transmise). Pagination native de la table Grafana (footer) — équivalent de la pagination 'Page 1 of 32' de NetFlow Analyzer sur un parc de 314 équipements.

value.title: Voir la fiche de cet exportateur
Voir les anomalies pour cette adresse

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    ExporterName AS exportateur,
    uniqExact(InIfName) AS interfaces,
    count() AS flux,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume,
    any(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(ExporterAddress), '::ffff:', '')) AS ip
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
GROUP BY ExporterName
ORDER BY flux DESC
LIMIT 350

panels.title: Alarmes récentes
panels.description: Équivalent du widget « Recent Alarms » de NetFlow Analyzer : liste les alertes Grafana déclenchées (exportateur muet, saturation d'interface, chute de trafic — voir stack/grafana/provisioning/alerting/). Panneau natif Grafana (grafana-alertlist), pas de requête ClickHouse — lit directement le moteur d'alerte interne.

panels.title: État des liens — répartition
panels.description: Équivalent du donut HeatMap de NetFlow Analyzer : Link Up (flux vus < 5 min) / Link Up & NoFlows (vu récemment mais rien depuis 5-30 min) / Link Down (rien depuis 30 min) / Unknown. Un lien = couple (exportateur, interface).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT etat, count() AS nb_liens
FROM (
    SELECT ExporterName, InIfName,
        multiIf(
            max(TimeReceived) < now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, 'Link Down',
            max(TimeReceived) < now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, 'Link Up & NoFlows',
            'Link Up'
        ) AS etat
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
        AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
        AND InIfName != ''
    GROUP BY ExporterName, InIfName
)
GROUP BY etat
ORDER BY nb_liens DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Grille des interfaces — un carré par lien
panels.description: Équivalent de la grille de carrés colorés de NetFlow Analyzer (772 interfaces chez lui) : un carré par couple (exportateur, interface), coloré selon son état. Cliquer une interface pointe vers la fiche de l'exportateur (dataLink).

links.title: Voir la fiche de cet exportateur

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    max(TimeReceived) AS time,
    concat(ExporterName, ' / ', InIfName) AS lien,
    multiIf(
        max(TimeReceived) < now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, 'Link Down',
        max(TimeReceived) < now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, 'Link Up & NoFlows',
        'Link Up'
    ) AS etat
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
    AND InIfName != ''
GROUP BY ExporterName, InIfName
ORDER BY lien
LIMIT 800

panels.title: Top N Protocol
panels.description: sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) par protocole IP nommé (TCP/UDP/ICMP/GRE/OSPF...), LIMIT 10.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    multiIf(
        Proto = 6, 'TCP',
        Proto = 17, 'UDP',
        Proto = 1, 'ICMP',
        Proto = 47, 'GRE',
        Proto = 89, 'OSPF',
        Proto = 112, 'VRRP',
        concat('Proto ', toString(Proto))
    ) AS protocole,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
GROUP BY protocole
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top N Application
panels.description: sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) par application déduite du protocole/port, LIMIT 20 — légendes en table (nom + volume lisible), comme les captures ManageEngine ('https -- 56.448 GB').

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    multiIf(
        Proto = 6 AND (DstPort = 443 OR SrcPort = 443), 'HTTPS',
        Proto = 6 AND (DstPort = 80 OR SrcPort = 80), 'HTTP',
        Proto = 17 AND (DstPort = 53 OR SrcPort = 53), 'DNS',
        Proto = 6, 'TCP autre',
        Proto = 17, 'UDP autre',
        Proto = 1, 'ICMP',
        'Autre'
    ) AS application,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
GROUP BY application
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top N QoS
panels.description: Classes DSCP nommées avec leur volume — DSCP = bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2), jamais l'opérateur >> (Code: 62 SYNTAX_ERROR mesuré). Classes mesurées en production sur ce ClickHouse : BE, EF, CS6, CS1, CS5.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    multiIf(
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 0, 'BE',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 8, 'CS1',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 10, 'AF11',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 16, 'CS2',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 18, 'AF21',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 24, 'CS3',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 26, 'AF31',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 32, 'CS4',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 34, 'AF41',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 40, 'CS5',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 46, 'EF',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 48, 'CS6',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 56, 'CS7',
        concat('DSCP ', toString(bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2)))
    ) AS classe_dscp,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
GROUP BY classe_dscp
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top N Conversation — Source / Destination / Application / DSCP / Traffic
panels.description: sum(Bytes * SamplingRate), LIMIT 25. Adresses démappées via IPv6NumToString (jamais cutIPv6 qui TRONQUE — mesuré).

value.title: Voir les anomalies pour cette adresse source
Voir les anomalies pour cette adresse destination

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS source,
    replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS destination,
    multiIf(
        Proto = 6 AND (DstPort = 443 OR SrcPort = 443), 'HTTPS',
        Proto = 6 AND (DstPort = 80 OR SrcPort = 80), 'HTTP',
        Proto = 17 AND (DstPort = 53 OR SrcPort = 53), 'DNS',
        Proto = 6, 'TCP autre',
        Proto = 17, 'UDP autre',
        Proto = 1, 'ICMP',
        'Autre'
    ) AS application,
    multiIf(
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 0, 'BE',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 46, 'EF',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 48, 'CS6',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 8, 'CS1',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 40, 'CS5',
        concat('DSCP ', toString(bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2)))
    ) AS dscp,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS traffic
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName IN (${exporter:singlequote})
GROUP BY source, destination, application, dscp
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT 25
